# Where gtk4 puts a label's text, and a box's children.
#
# A GtkLabel centers its words in the room it is given, and gtk4 read no
# `alignItems`, `textAlign` or width of a label but as a size request, so
# each pair below drew the same picture: a stretched label's text centered
# as a centered label's was, a `textAlign=center` changed nothing, and a
# label 96 wide with a long line was as wide as the line. Now `ui.text`
# starts its lines at the left, as html's does, and each pair differs.
# pkg/go/gtk4rt/style_test.go measures what GTK lays out of them, and
# testdata/gtk4_style.txtar shows the calls.
#
# Confirmed by reverting the gtk4 change: each pair of snapshots was then the
# same picture.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=gtk4 app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/stretched.png app.sngl.snapshots/centered.png
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/stretched.png app.sngl.snapshots/textCentered.png
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/long.png app.sngl.snapshots/wrapped.png

# The same on the cgo path, which a toggle puts a file on: its children were
# appended with GTK's own call, which left a box's alignItems unread, so a
# centered box drew as a plain one. They go through gtk4rt now.
sngl test --platform=gtk4 cgo.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'
! cmp cgo.sngl.snapshots/centered.png cgo.sngl.snapshots/plain.png

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

output { go { gtk4 } }

component stretched ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text(value="a name")
    }
}

component centered ui.node {
    ui.vbox(style={alignItems=center}) {
        ui.text(value="a name")
    }
}

component textCentered ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text(value="a name", style={textAlign=center})
    }
}

component long ui.node {
    ui.hbox {
        ui.text(value="a line much longer than ninety-six pixels")
    }
}

component wrapped ui.node {
    ui.hbox {
        ui.text(value="a line much longer than ninety-six pixels", style={width=96px})
    }
}

func testStretched(t test.Test, c stretched) {
    t.snapshot("stretched")
}

func testCentered(t test.Test, c centered) {
    t.snapshot("centered")
}

func testTextCentered(t test.Test, c textCentered) {
    t.snapshot("textCentered")
}

func testLong(t test.Test, c long) {
    t.snapshot("long")
}

func testWrapped(t test.Test, c wrapped) {
    t.snapshot("wrapped")
}

ui.window {
    stretched
}
-- cgo.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

output { go { gtk4 } }

component centered ui.node {
    var on = true
    ui.vbox(style={alignItems=center}) {
        ui.text(value="a name")
        ui.toggle(checked=on)
    }
}

component plain ui.node {
    var on = true
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text(value="a name")
        ui.toggle(checked=on)
    }
}

func testCentered(t test.Test, c centered) {
    t.snapshot("centered")
}

func testPlain(t test.Test, c plain) {
    t.snapshot("plain")
}

ui.window {
    centered
}
